import fluentqt
from PySide6.QtCore import Qt
from PySide6.QtWidgets import QVBoxLayout
python.setup:
control = fluentqt.SplitView(%PARENT%)
for title_text, summary_text in [
    ("Navigation", "Folders, saved views and quick filters."),
    ("Workspace", "Active document canvas and inspector details."),
]:
    pane = fluentqt.Card()
    lay = QVBoxLayout(pane)
    lay.setContentsMargins(16, 14, 16, 14)
    lay.setSpacing(6)
    title = fluentqt.Label(title_text, pane)
    title.setFluentTypography(fluentqt.FontRole.Subtitle)
    lay.addWidget(title)
    summary = fluentqt.Label(summary_text, pane)
    summary.setWordWrap(True)
    summary.setTextColorRole(fluentqt.Label.TextColorRole.Secondary)
    lay.addWidget(summary)
    lay.addStretch()
    control.addOwnedPane(pane)
control.setPanePreferredSize(0, 220)
control.setPanePreferredSize(1, 294)
control.setPaneFill(1, True)
